The engineer's deposition testimony is inadmissible because the company did not have an opportunity to cross-examine him on the liability issue for which the statement is now being offered — the deposition occurred in the wrongful termination case, where the issues differed from the pilot's products liability claim. Although the engineer was a party opponent's agent when he made the statements, the prior deposition from separate litigation cannot be used against the company on these new liability issues without a meaningful opportunity to cross-examine on that issue. 
CONFIDENCE: 70
